3	"""

5	import asyncio
6	import json

8	from datetime import datetime
9	from typing import Dict
10	import websockets
11	from websockets.exceptions import ConnectionClosed
12	from aiohttp import web
13	
14	
15	class ClientRegistry:
16	    """Thread-safe registry of connected WebSocket clients."""
17	
18	    def __init__(self):
19	        self.clients: Dict[str, object] = {}
20	        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()
21	
22	    async def register(self, client_id: str, websocket: object):
23	        async with self.lock:
24	            self.clients[client_id] = websocket
25	
26	    async def unregister(self, client_id: str):
27	        async with self.lock:
28	            self.clients.pop(client_id, None)
29	
30	    async def get_client_count(self) -> int:
31	        async with self.lock:
32	            return len(self.clients)
33	
34	    async def broadcast(self, message: dict):
35	        """Send message to all connected clients."""
36	        async with self.lock:
37	            disconnected = set()
38	            for client_id, websocket in self.clients.items():
39	                try:
40	                    await websocket.send(json.dumps(message))
41	                except (ConnectionClosed, Exception):
42	                    disconnected.add(client_id)
43	
44	        for client_id in disconnected:
45	            await self.unregister(client_id)
46	
47	    async def send_direct(self, client_id: str, message: dict):
48	        """Send message to specific client."""
49	        async with self.lock:
50	            websocket = self.clients.get(client_id)
51	
52	        if websocket:
53	            try:
54	                await websocket.send(json.dumps(message))
55	            except (ConnectionClosed, Exception):
56	                await self.unregister(client_id)
57	
58	
59	# Global registry
60	registry = ClientRegistry()
61	
62	
63	def create_message(msg_type: str, payload: dict) -> dict:
64	    """Create a properly formatted message."""
65	    return {
66	        "type": msg_type,
67	        "payload": payload,
68	        "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
69	    }
70	
71	
72	async def websocket_handler(websocket):
73	    """Handle WebSocket connection."""
74	    client_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
75	
76	    # Register client
77	    await registry.register(client_id, websocket)
78	
79	    # Notify all clients of new connection
80	    await registry.broadcast(
81	        create_message("system", {"event": "client_joined", "client_id": client_id})
82	    )
83	
84	    try:
85	        async for raw_message in websocket:
86	            try:
87	                message = json.loads(raw_message)
88	                msg_type = message.get("type")
89	
90	                if msg_type == "broadcast":
91	                    await registry.broadcast(
92	                        create_message("broadcast", message.get("payload", {}))
93	                    )
94	                elif msg_type == "direct":
95	                    target_client_id = message.get("target_client_id")
96	                    if target_client_id:
97	                        await registry.send_direct(
98	                            target_client_id,
99	                            create_message("direct", message.get("payload", {})),
100	                        )
101	                else:
102	                    await websocket.send(
103	                        json.dumps(
104	                            create_message("system", {"error": f"Unknown message type: {msg_type}"})
105	                        )
106	                    )
107	            except json.JSONDecodeError:
108	                await websocket.send(
109	                    json.dumps(create_message("system", {"error": "Invalid JSON"}))
110	                )
111	    except ConnectionClosed:
112	        pass
113	    finally:
114	        # Unregister client
115	        await registry.unregister(client_id)
116	        # Notify all clients of disconnection
117	        await registry.broadcast(
118	            create_message("system", {"event": "client_left", "client_id": client_id})
119	        )
120	
121	
122	async def health_handler(request):
123	    """Health check endpoint returning connected client count."""
124	    count = await registry.get_client_count()
125	    return web.json_response({"status": "ok", "connected_clients": count})
126

128	async def start_servers():
129	    """Start both WebSocket and REST servers."""
130	    async with websockets.serve(websocket_handler, "localhost", 8765):
131	        app = web.Application()
132	        app.router.add_get("/health", health_handler)
133	        runner = web.AppRunner(app)
134	        await runner.setup()
135	        site = web.TCPSite(runner, "localhost", 8766)
136	        await site.start()
137	
138	        print("WebSocket server running on ws://localhost:8765")
139	        print("REST API running on http://localhost:8766")
140	
141	        try:
142	            await asyncio.Event().wait()
143	        except KeyboardInterrupt:
144	            pass
145	        finally:
146	            await runner.cleanup()
147	
148	
149	if __name__ == "__main__":
150	    asyncio.run(start_servers())
